_doc: Sound set made with Higgsfield seed_audio (format wav). Every prompt = base + 'The sound: ' + prompt. py -3 tools/sfx_process.py turns the raw wavs into assets/audio/sfx/<id>.wav (trim, fade, filter, level). max = seconds kept, gain = dB after normalising to -3 dBFS peak.
base: Foley sound effect for a dark fairy-tale pixel-art game, no speech, no music. World style: intimate dry close-miked foley in a cold twilight forest, natural worn materials (oiled blue steel, aged leather, damp wood, moss, cold stone), muted soft highs, short natural air tail with a faint cold violet shimmer as if touched by a void, no big reverb, no synth.

sounds.prompt: one quick one-handed sword slash through the air, a thin steel whoosh with a slight leather creak of the grip, ends cleanly.
a slightly lower and slower backhand sword slash through the air, a thin steel whoosh, ends cleanly.
a sword blade striking a shadow creature, a dull wet-dark thud with a short steel ring and a faint cold shimmer.
a short magical blink: a sharp air pop and a cold rising shimmer as a body vanishes into shadow.
a short soft arrival pop with a fading cold shimmer and a light cloth rustle.
a young woman's short pained grunt when struck, no words, breathy and strained.
a young woman's sharp pained gasp when struck, no words, short.
a quiet dry clicking hiss as a spider notices prey, rasping chitin.
a shadow spider's sickle-like claw sweeping through the air with a dry chitin scrape and a low hiss.
a spider leg slamming into the ground with a wet dark thud and a rasping hiss.
a shadow spider's short wet shriek of pain, rasping and slightly glitchy.
a shadow spider collapsing: a wet rasping shriek fading into a dry crumble of chitin and a cold shimmer.
a hand axe biting into a living fir trunk, a hard dull wooden chock with a short woody ring.
a big tree trunk cracking, then falling with creaking snapping branches and a heavy thud on mossy ground.
a pickaxe striking stone, a sharp metallic clink with a stony crack and small chips flying.
a rock crumbling into rubble, a gravelly cracking crumble that settles.
a sickle cutting tough grass stems, a quick crisp swish and snip.
a hand plucking berries from a bush, a soft leaf rustle and a small wet snap.
a bite into a juicy berry, a crisp small crunch and a short soft chew.
a small item popping out and landing on moss, a soft pop and a tiny dull plop.
a small item swept up, a quick light airy whoosh and one tiny soft glassy chime.
a few old copper coins clinking together in a hand, soft dull metal chimes.
a leather satchel being opened, soft leather rustle and a small buckle click.
a leather satchel being closed, soft leather rustle and a small buckle click.
picking a small item out of a cloth bag, a soft cloth rustle and a tiny tick.
setting a small item down on wood, a soft wooden tick.
buckling on a piece of leather and steel gear, a short leather creak and a metal clink.
a tiny soft wooden tick like a bead on a string.
a small dry wooden tap.
a soft warm wooden knock with a faint cold shimmer fading after it.
a soft muted lower wooden tap.
an old parchment map unrolling, a long paper rustle with a faint cold shimmer.
an old parchment map rolling up quickly, a short paper rustle.
a heavy wooden post set into soil, a dull thud and a creak of timber.
wooden planks pulled apart and clattering down, creaking splintering wood.
one soft footstep pushing through dry fallen leaves, a quick crisp rustle.
crickets chirping softly at night in grass, a steady gentle trill.
a gentle daytime breeze moving through tree leaves, a soft steady rustling hush.
a cold low night wind moving through bare branches, a soft hollow moan.
a calm small river flowing over stones, soft steady water babbling.
a small campfire crackling, soft steady wood pops and a low flame hiss.
a wild rabbit's single hard hind-foot thump on packed earth, one short dull low knock, nothing else.
a hedgehog snuffling through dry leaf litter, quick wet little sniffs, soft huffs and tiny rustles.
a badger's low gruff grunt from the chest, one deep huff and a short rough breath.
a roe deer's single sharp hoarse bark, loud and abrupt like a coughing dog.
a red fox's single short hoarse bark, sharp and a little raspy.
one honey bee flying past close, a soft wing buzz that rises and fades.
a brown bear's low rumbling growl, a deep chest rumble with a rough wet snarl.
a brown bear's loud roar, raw and deep, breaking into a rough growl at the end.
a carrion crow's single hoarse 'kraa' caw, harsh and dry, outdoors.
three short harsh crow caws in a quick row, 'kra kra kra'.
a crow's soft low conversational croak, quiet and rolling, as if talking to its flock.
a raven's deep resonant 'kronk' croak, much lower and more hollow than a crow.
a raven's long rolling gargling call, deep, hollow and slightly metallic.
a large black bird taking off from the ground, a few heavy wing flaps and a quick feather rustle.
a bird landing on a branch, a quick feather flutter and a soft light touch of claws on wood.
a barn owl's long raspy screech at night, breathy and eerie, far from sharp.
a hoopoe's soft hollow 'hoo-poo-poo' call, three gentle low notes.

_packs: Free seed_audio queues ~7 min per job, so several short sounds go into ONE clip (separated by ~1 s of silence, prompt in packs[].prompt is built from the sound prompts) and sfx_process.py cuts it apart. item_take is a single job.
animal_base: Realistic close wildlife field recording of the real animal, true to life, no cartoon, no exaggeration, recorded outdoors at dusk with the animal fairly close, dry with only a short natural tail.
_animals: Animal sounds use base + animal_base (realism clause) so they stay true to life but sit in the same dusk-forest mix.
